state.description: Public/private channels, IMs and group DMs keyed by conversation id. is_member and num_members are computed per actor, never stored.
Messages keyed "<channelId>:<ts>" so a prefix scan yields one conversation in ts order. Replies carry thread_ts; a parent with replies carries thread_ts equal to its own ts.
Pinned messages keyed "<channelId>:<ts>"; the message's pinned_to is kept in sync.
Workspace members keyed by user id; read-only through the API in this version.

message_sequence.description: Six-digit ts fraction of the last message allocated in message_second; restarts at 0 in every new virtual second (at most 999,999 timestamps per second, then chat.postMessage, chat.reply, conversations.join and conversations.invite fail with TOO_MANY_ROWS).

message_second.description: Virtual epoch second the current message_sequence belongs to. Absent in authored data: the first allocation sets it and restarts the sequence.

limits.description: Optional row bounds this synthetic workspace serves (defaults: users 1000, conversations 1000, members 1000 per conversation, messages 10000 per conversation, pins 100 per conversation, response_bytes 900000 per list or read response). A read that finds more rows fails with TOO_MANY_ROWS; pins.add refuses to exceed pins. Lists and reads size each page to response_bytes of UTF-8 encoded JSON and return a next cursor; one item that alone exceeds it fails with response_too_large (users, conversations and member ids with too_many_rows).

state.description: The single workspace row (rowId "team"): identity, literal url, the counters that feed generated ids and ts values, and optional row bounds.

connections.title: Reference Slack MCP tool names (slack_list_channels, slack_post_message, ...)
connections.instructions: Connect a Streamable HTTP MCP client to SLACK_MCP_URL with SLACK_MCP_TOKEN as a Bearer token. The eight tool names of the archived reference Slack MCP server are exposed as aliases next to the canonical slack.<operation> names.

connections.title: Slack Web API client (base URL override)
connections.instructions: Point the client's API base at SLACK_API_URL + '/api/' (@slack/web-api: slackApiUrl; slack_sdk: base_url) and pass SLACK_BOT_TOKEN as the token; the value is the isolated world token, not a real xoxb token. Test processes only. Errors come back with HTTP 4xx/5xx status codes and Slack-shaped { ok: false, error } bodies; write methods accept application/x-www-form-urlencoded only.
